# OscInt

> A Lean 4 + Mathlib library of machine-checked uniform oscillatory-integral estimates with explicit constants: van der Corput (every derivative order, and the sharp second-derivative constant), stationary phase, fold, cusp and D4 umbilic bounds, lattice Schrödinger kernels and groups on Z^d, rings and chains, the Hadamard quantum walk, the exponentially convergent trapezoidal rule, and the Kusmin–Landau inequality. Statements are frozen and timestamped before their Lean proofs; proofs are replayed by six kernel checkers. Author: Thomas Falk III (ORCID 0009-0001-9478-6061). Cite: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24021328. Code Apache-2.0, documentation CC BY 4.0; see NOTICE for the required attribution.

Proofs and reviews are by AI agents directed by the author; no human expert has reviewed the statements. Read "Known caveats" in the README before relying on a result. Release v0.7.0 has 86 pinned statements, all machine-checked as stated; the development branch has 4 more (batch SPL: the leading term of a quadratic-phase integral with an explicit remainder), machine-checked as stated since 2026-11-20 (proved, post-proof reviews answered, full replay recorded in docs/replay/2026-11-20-SPL-verify-all.txt), not yet in a release; and 4 more (batch TRI: the singularity types of the anisotropic triangular lattice phase), frozen on 2026-11-27 and proved in Lean the same day; full replay and post-proof review pending.
